/scripts.value:
command generateQuestionOrderList
	if randomizeQuestions then
		put randomCSV(numberOfQuestions) into questionOrderList
	else
		put generateList(numberOfQuestions) into questionOrderList
	end if
end generateQuestionOrderList

function randomCSV pMax
	 local tList, i, j, temp, tResult
	 
	 //Create ordered list
	 repeat with i = 1 to pMax
		 put i into tList[i]
	 end repeat
	 
	 //Shuffle list (Fisher-Yates)
	 repeat with i = pMax down to 2
		 put random(i) into j
		 
		 put tList[i] into temp
		 put tList[j] into tList[i]
		 put temp into tList[j]
	 end repeat
	 
	 //Convert to comma-separated string
	 repeat with i = 1 to pMax
		 put tList[i] after tResult
		 if i < pMax then
			put "," after tResult
		end if
	 end repeat
	 
	 return tResult
end randomCSV

function generateList pMax
	local tList
	
	repeat with x = 1 to pMax
		put x & comma after tList
	end repeat
	delete char -1 of tList
	
	return tList
end generateList
